title: Scheduling policy and routing
brief: Add aging to a priority queue, keep Virtual Token Counter shares fair for a late joiner, and route a seeded trace across replicas by prefix hit rate with a bounded load.
hints: A step costs base + per_token * tokens. Solve for tokens and round down.

Lift a client's counter when it arrives with an empty queue: take the larger of its own counter and the smallest counter among the backlogged clients. Without the lift, a newcomer at 0 takes every slot.
Rank replicas by match, then by queued work. Cap the in-flight count at ceil((1 + epsilon) * (total + 1) / n) so one hot prefix cannot pile onto one replica.
